profile.headline: Mid-level Software Engineer
profile.summary: I am a mid-level software engineer who gets work done and communicates with stakeholders to make sure it's done right. I have experience developing web apps and backend APIs, as well as some frontend experience even if it's not my specialty. I pride myself in being communicative, reliable, and easy to work with.

- Welcomed panelists and ensured they had anything they needed.
- Managed any lines that formed and answered questions from attendees.

projects.title: Viability of Azure IoT Hub for Processing High Velocity Large Scale IoT Data
projects.description: Worked with another student to test the performance of the Microsoft Azure IoT Hub when inundated with a giant amount of traffic in a short period of time. We took advantage of Clemson's supercomputer to mimic thousands of sensors in a manufacturing environment and send a flurry of messages to IoT Hub under different configurations to see how this would affect round-trip latency. If the system exceeded IoT Hub specifications, there was significant variation in latency. However, the results were well-behaved if we stayed within the guidelines.

projects.title: Research in Student Career Readiness using Natural Language Processing
projects.description:
Collaborated with the Michelin Career Center to analyze student intern survey responses for leadership language to gain insight into career readiness and competency development using Natural Language Processing.
I labeled textual data, cleaned it, ran it through a FastText word embedding model, and performed a logistic regression.
I served as the team leader for 2 out of my 3 semesters and presented our work twice at the annual AI Symposium at Clemson University with my team.
Our paper won the 2022 Tyler Award for distinguished excellence for an outstanding article in the field of Cooperative Education and Internships.

Managed relations between our ministry and Clemson University.
Developed a group dedicated to showing hospitality to international students through friendships, games, and food.

organizations.name: Clemson Baptist Collegiate Ministries
organizations.description:
Led a team of 5 to plan and execute events for our organization
Organized meetings and fostered a vision for our team.
Wrote planning documents in Google Docs and occasionally created promotional videos and graphics for our events using Adobe Premiere and Photoshop.
Worked with our staff and other team leaders to monitor the health of our organization and plot a direction for growth.
